title: Sign-in and sign-out
body: A person signs in with Logto: the Sign In button in the header, or opening a page that needs an account, takes them to the Logto sign-in page. ^p3xm
After signing in, the person returns to the page they started from. Only an address inside the product is accepted as that page; any other address returns them to the home page. ^sgpk
When signing in fails or takes longer than 15 seconds, the page says that sign-in failed and offers to sign in again. ^68hs
The first request of a person without a profile creates their profile with the role `USER`. ^f48m
Signing out ends the session in Logto as well and signs the person out in every open tab of the product. ^mpv2
